comparison.conclusion: D629 completed 4000 native-contract requests, but observed joint SLO is 3727/4000 (93.175%). Relative to D621 it is lower by 1.775 percentage points, P95 TTFT is 17.756% higher and physical GPU time 2.841% higher. Reject this candidate as a performance improvement; retain the complete run. The extra mean TTFT is concentrated in acquire-to-resume, which includes permit waiting and wakeup delay, not a proven causal effect of the lock change. No same-key rerun, cross-scene splicing, independent numerical qualification or final G1/G2 claim.
